environment.clock_power_policy: Uncontrolled consumer-laptop conditions. No clocks, power limit, driver, registry, Windows, WSL, or other system setting was changed.

primary_end_to_end.operation: exactly one cuda_decoder_attention_forward_ call per sample
primary_end_to_end.completion_synchronization: one synchronization after warmup and one on the final queued end event per round; elapsed samples extracted afterward

synchronized_wall.sample_boundary: synchronize, start timer, one public call, synchronize, stop timer

isolated_stages.stage_input_policy: all prerequisite outputs are prepared before the isolated stage's timed region using existing public primitives
isolated_stages.metadata_views: head reshapes and context flatten are untimed zero-kernel views

statistics.across_rounds: median/minimum/maximum of round medians plus max/min ratio
statistics.outlier_policy: retain every sample; no filtering or rerun selection

methodology.repeated_cache_mutation: At fixed P, every T=1 invocation recomputes K/V and overwrites the same slot P. No full cache reset, clone, or copy occurs in a timed region; every invocation sees the same logical prefix and x.

representative_weight_generation.description: Four independent deterministic dense FP32 normal source matrices, quantized by the frozen quantize_nvfp4_reference. They are representative random weights, not trained weights.
representative_weight_generation.storage_transfer: portable NVFP4 storage copied to CUDA after quantization

q_weight.name: q_weight
q_weight.description: deterministic representative random weight; not trained-model data

k_weight.name: k_weight
k_weight.description: deterministic representative random weight; not trained-model data

v_weight.name: v_weight
v_weight.description: deterministic representative random weight; not trained-model data

out_weight.name: out_weight
out_weight.description: deterministic representative random weight; not trained-model data

hidden_states.b1_policy: batch 0 view of the same B=2 master hidden-state fixture

master_cache.b1_policy: batch 0 of the same B=2 CPU master cache
master_cache.unused_suffix: populated with deterministic finite values; attention uses only S
master_cache.fresh_case_policy: Each correctness or timing case starts from the corresponding B slice of the same master cache. Before each benchmark round, slot P is restored outside timing; the prefix is never changed by repeated T=1 calls.

fixture.fixed_capacity_reason: C=16384 is held constant so changing P changes only logical S=P+1, not the physical K/V batch-head stride or cache allocation size.

correctness_precheck.cache_mutation_semantics: Each invocation recomputes and overwrites only slot P for T=1; the logical prefix is unchanged and is shared across repetitions.

end_to_end_stream_elapsed_us.interpretation: Elapsed stream interval between start and end events around one public pipeline call. It can include stream-visible idle gaps from Python host submission when the GPU catches up; it is not a sum of pure kernel execution times or host-free arithmetic time.

persistent_inputs_and_state.x: BF16 [B,1,3072] (B=1 uses batch 0 of the B=2 master input)
persistent_inputs_and_state.normalization_weights: BF16 input gamma [3072], Q gamma [128], K gamma [128]

pipeline_outputs_and_intermediates.name: KV append
pipeline_outputs_and_intermediates.dtype_shape: in-place writes to persistent cache slot P

allocation_accounting.allocator_caveat: Source-level tensor allocations are not physical cudaMalloc counts; PyTorch uses a CUDA caching allocator and can reuse blocks.

next_milestone_recommendation.recommendation: For M7, investigate an isolated same-semantics cached-attention algorithm/materialization optimization, with the first goal of reducing or eliminating the separate FP32 score and probability materializations. Keep projection-backend promotion as a separate future end-to-end A/B because short-context regimes may still be projection-led.
next_milestone_recommendation.boundary: Stage attribution supports relative prioritization only. No DRAM-, L2-, compute-, instruction-, SFU-, or occupancy-bound cause is asserted without hardware counters.

limitations: One RTX 4080 Laptop GPU and one captured run under uncontrolled consumer-laptop clocks, thermals, and power.
CUDA-event stream intervals can include stream-visible idle gaps from Python submission; they are not sums of pure kernel execution time.
Synchronized wall latency includes synchronization and allocator/orchestration effects; wall-minus-stream is not isolated host overhead.
Isolated-stage medians are non-additive and are used only for ranking and decomposition.
The PyTorch allocator peak is not physical VRAM traffic, bandwidth, or a cudaMalloc count.
Analytical logical bytes are not measured memory traffic or DRAM bandwidth.
No Nsight Compute hardware counters were collected; no DRAM-, L2-, compute-, instruction-, SFU-, or occupancy-bound claim is made.
The deterministic dense random weights are representative fixtures, not trained-model weights.
The caching allocator and CUDA path are warmed; this is a steady-state modular-path baseline rather than cold-start latency.
Cases run in the documented fixed B-major, ascending-P order; all samples and timing-level changes are retained.
No comparison to native Blackwell FP4, FlashAttention, cuBLAS, TensorRT-LLM, or another model/server is made because semantics are not matched.
